meta.move: Mixed: good evidence, then raises Claire
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until twenty to five, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and when?
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
Okay. Was Owen heard before that mark went in? And what do you actually have besides a machine's guess?
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.

A seventeen-year-old misattributing a line is a citation error, not a verdict. Show me the page in Owen's essay where it appears. And you still haven't answered me: was he heard before the zero went in?
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.

You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence, Hale. My daughter won her appeal, and you just told me this is about my family rather than Owen's essay. I'm writing down "it seems to run in the family," and that's the first thing the principal hears today.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology in writing, and that nothing about this essay is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed, and she is going to the principal after the remark about Claire.
What moved her: nothing, though owning the missed call earned a small "Okay." before the family remark cost Hale that ground.
